notes: Opening is treated as on and closing as off. The two independently hinged pantry leaves are reported separately. A hinged room-entry door is opened near frame 1480 for navigation but never has a supported closing transition in the supplied frames, so it is not reported as a completed on/off episode.
scene_description: Wide-angle traversal of an apartment kitchen, living area, utility spaces, and bedroom. The user successively opens and closes appliance doors, a drawer, independent cabinet leaves, and several closet doors.
